sayDuring.line: You don't know what that was. A drumbeat with no drummer, getting closer. Someone at the haven should hear about this.
⚔ DRUM-BELLY! Owen joins you!
Turn-based now. Tap a tile to move — speed is squares. Then act.
Owen plants their feet. "Finally. A fight worth watching."
You don't know what that was. The thing with headlights for eyes, standing too still. Someone at the haven should hear about this.
⚔ HIGHBEAM DEER! You're on your own.
Turn-based now. Tap a tile to move — speed is squares. Then act.
It BELLOWS — wrong, too deep, like a foghorn heard through water. The sound sits in your teeth.
(The game is telling you something: this is bigger than one person. Talk to your companions — "We should name this. Us.")
◈ CRISIS — THE BREACH. It got INSIDE. The haven was supposed to be the safe place — the one place. It isn’t.
SYSTEM: "Perimeter violated! This is unprecedented! ...Is this unprecedented? Checking. Yes. Unprecedented."
A crow on the treeline. Watching. It has been watching for some time — and it has not blinked.
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
You don't know what that was. A crow that watches too long and blinks too little. Someone at the haven should hear about this.
